name: Dividing A Church
overview: Scripture warns against divisions within the church by emphasizing the importance of walking worthy of the calling in Christ and doing the will of the Father, rather than merely professing faith. Believers are called to receive those weak in faith with patience and avoid engaging in contentious disputes, while also exercising discernment by rejecting persistent heresy after correction. Recognizing that all have sinned and fall short of God's glory, the church is to maintain unity through humility and truth, guarding against divisions that stem from false teachings or judgmental attitudes.
